items.name: php2shell-patches
items.description: php2shell (CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619) security patches for EOL PHP 5.4–8.1. Official & enhanced backports for vanilla php.net and Remi Collet trees. Restores safe file uploads & progress bars without RCE. Fleet-tested on OpenCart, WordPress, HestiaCP, aaPanel.

items.name: php-focal-backports
items.description: Rebuild the PPA's patched php8.1 (PHP2Shell) for Ubuntu 20.04 and 26.04, arm64 or amd64

items.name: php2shell-legacy-patcher
items.description: PHP2Shell patching toolkit for legacy PHP on CentOS 7 and Ubuntu 18.04: vendor package rebuilds and runtime verification.

items.name: php2shell-check
items.description: Backport-aware PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619) checker for installed PHP packages; knows distro and vendor fixed builds, incl. patched PHP 5.6-8.4 for CentOS 7

items.name: php2shell-patch-audit
items.description: Read-only PHP2Shell patch auditing for Linux, Windows, and macOS, with local, SSH, and container inspection, vendor backport support, and explicit UNKNOWN results.

items.name: reliqua
items.description: Read-only PHP runtime patch evidence: stale workers, reviewed vendor backports, and fresh reports for every declared node.

items.name: synology-dsm6-php74-php2shell
items.description: Unofficial patched PHP 7.4.33 for Synology DSM 6.2 x86_64 (replaces PHP7.4 7.4.30-0009). Fixes PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619) plus 90 security backports. Drop-in install with backup and rollback, test page, build scripts. Tested on DS1815+.

items.name: php-7.2-CVE-2026-109618-109619
items.description: Unofficial security backport: source patch for end-of-life PHP 7.2 addressing CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619 (php2shell), ported from the official PHP 7.4 backport. Unsupported, no warranty, limited verification.

items.name: php-7.3-CVE-2026-109618-109619
items.description: Unofficial security backport: source patch for end-of-life PHP 7.3 addressing CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619 (php2shell), ported from the official PHP 7.4 backport. Unsupported, no warranty, limited verification.

items.name: docker-php-legacy
items.description: End-of-life PHP (5.6, 7.1-8.1) patched against php2shell, built from Remi Collet's security backports: Composer, WP-CLI, msmtp, Supercronic, extensions enabled via env.

items.name: phpguard
items.description: Defensive toolkit for PHP servers after PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/9): fleet patch audit incl. distro backports & end-of-life PHP, php.ini hardening, owner-only website leak check, and access-log attack detection with canary traps. A–F graded, fix-first reports. Python, no dependencies.
